sloka: लक्ष्मणः तु महातेजाः सत्त्ववान् शीलवान् शुचिः ।अब्रवीत् प्रांजलिः वाक्यम् भ्रातरम् दीप्त तेजसम् ॥३-६९-२०॥
transliteration: lakṣmaṇaḥ tu mahātejāḥ sattvavān śīlavān śuciḥ ।abravīt prāṁjaliḥ vākyam bhrātaram dīpta tejasam ॥3-69-20॥

translations.english: Lakshmana of great brilliance and power, of good conduct and pure character spoke to his highly effulgent brother with folded hands:
